import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from tools.computation_doctor import audit

root=Path('out/corpus/j081')
profiles=[]
for group,name in [('existing','graph-profiles.json'),('reanalysis','reanalysis-profiles.json')]:
    for original in json.loads((root/name).read_text()):
        if group=='existing':
            path=root/'graph-inputs'/(original['case']+'.db')
        else:
            path=root/'reanalysis-inputs'/original['case']/'state.db'
        before=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert before==original['database_sha256']
        report=audit(path)
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
        assert report['status']=='recorded' and report['summary']['errors']==0,report['findings']
        old=original['report'].copy()
        new=report.copy()
        old.pop('exclusions')
        new.pop('exclusions')
        new.pop('target_links')
        new['summary']={key:value for key,value in new['summary'].items() if key!='warnings' and not key.startswith('target_')}
        warnings=[finding for finding in new['findings'] if finding['level']=='warning']
        assert all(row['code']=='application_target_unavailable' for row in warnings)
        new['findings']=[finding for finding in new['findings'] if finding['level']!='warning']
        assert old==new,(group,original['case'])
        profiles.append({'group':group,'case':original['case'],'database_sha256':before,'database_unchanged':True,'prior_graph_fields_equal':True,'new_warnings':warnings,'report':report})
assert len(profiles)==112
Path('out/corpus/j082/target-profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(profiles,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'profiles':len(profiles),'old_graph_fields_unchanged':True,'new_warning_count':sum(len(row['new_warnings']) for row in profiles),'warning_cases':[row['case'] for row in profiles if row['new_warnings']]}))

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from tests.harness import RCL
from tests.scenario.test_rcl_name_rollover import next_term, waiting_world
from tests.scenario.test_request_doctor import snapshot
from tools.computation_doctor import audit


def test_profile():
    root=Path('out/corpus/j082/rollover-inputs')
    root.mkdir()
    profiles=[]
    for model in ('gpt-5.1','claude-opus-5-5'):
        for workers in (1,4):
            world=waiting_world(workers=workers,model=model)
            world.batch.resolve()
            world.run()
            prior=world.repo.get(10,RCL)
            assert prior is not None and prior.editorial.mnemonic is not None
            assert any(row.target is not None and row.target.kind=='editorial' for row in world.repo.list_result_applications(10,RCL))
            next_term(world)
            world.repo.restore(world.repo.dump())
            moved=world.run(term=None)
            assert moved.rehomed==1 and world.repo.get(10,RCL) is None
            assert sum(row.call_kind=='name' for row in world.batch.submitted)==1
            case=f'{model}-{workers}'
            directory=root/case
            directory.mkdir()
            path=snapshot(world,directory)
            before=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            report=audit(path)
            assert report['status']=='recorded' and not report['findings'],report['findings']
            assert any(row['kind']=='editorial' and row['status']=='historical_owner_absent' for row in report['target_links'])
            assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
            profiles.append({'case':case,'database_sha256':before,'database_unchanged':True,'report':report})
    assert len(profiles)==4
    Path('out/corpus/j082/rollover-profiles.json').write_text(json.dumps(profiles,indent=2)+'\n')
